name: Jelly Portal
description: Adds a permanent icon to the header of the Jellyfin web client that reflects the overall state of your self-hosted services as reported by your status portal (up, degraded, down, maintenance in progress or coming up). Clicking it opens a panel with the details: services, maintenance windows and announcements. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Shows your status portal's state as an icon in the Jellyfin web header.

- summary: pass the configured polling interval on to the browser (1cfec46)
- injection: add the plugin's script and stylesheet to index.html through File Transformation (e8fae0e)
- dev: a strict fake portal and the dev loop (3335add)
- api: cache the portal reading and serve GET /JellyPortal/Summary (74abf5b)
- portal: read the portal's display-device API and hold the settings (7a50615)
- summary: read the portal's display-device answer (d369815)
- summary: compute the icon state and the panel content from a portal reading (534d867)
